title: Final Answers
description: Essential criteria include correct final answers for radius, length, time, magnetic field, and deflection angle.

title: Length Contraction
description: Important criteria involve correctly applying the Lorentz contraction to find the length of the bunch in the observer's frame.

title: Magnetic Field Calculation
description: Important criteria require the correct application of Ampère's law to derive the magnetic field in the laboratory frame.

title: Time Calculation
description: Important criteria include correctly calculating the time taken for the bunches to pass through each other.

title: Deflection Angle Derivation
description: Important criteria involve deriving the deflection angle using the magnetic field and momentum considerations.

title: Unit Consistency
description: Optional criteria include ensuring that all units are consistent throughout the calculations.

title: Sign Errors
description: Pitfall criteria involve common errors such as incorrect signs in velocity or magnetic field calculations.

title: Missing Factors
description: Pitfall criteria include failing to include necessary factors in the equations, such as constants or conversion factors.
